title: Improving Generalizability in Implicitly Abusive Language Detection with Concept Activation Vectors
reasoning: The paper focuses on technical methods to improve the generalizability of abusive language detection models (specifically RoBERTa-based models) using Concept Activation Vectors. While the subject matter (anti-Asian racism) and the final section ('Ethical Considerations') touch on ethics, the core of the research is an engineering and interpretability challenge rather than a study or benchmark of ethics, morals, or religion.
